explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 114 to 69 lines (39.5%) and from 8,920 to 5,941 characters (33.4%). Four peripherals give retry behavior, edit preparation, transcript delivery and isolated-result publication their primary explanatory locations. M = modular structure, C = calls, O = ownership, D = data dependency. The regenerated set totals 162 lines, versus 182 previously.

Following the critique, the center emphasizes boundaries, inputs and publication consequences; numeric limits and detailed mechanisms sit in peripherals. Textual handoffs identify the related point IDs supplied by context.json without recreating those points. Peripherals sit beside their principal attachment rows. All trees use printable ASCII; their measured rectangles do not overlap, all edge endpoints exist, and every diagram is connected. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Source-grounded corrections: agentChatRoutes.ts:23-27,54-90 applies bounded tool previews only to SSE snapshots, not ordinary session responses; :8-14 removes generation.history but retains inputHistory. agentChatService.ts:410-459 records request IDs before submission and does not remove them on failure, so duplicate suppression does not prove execution. Its :319-340 saves the terminal child before the synchronization try/finally; failure of that save can bypass controller/binding cleanup. generationCanvasBridge.ts:33-89 exposes a restricted isolated command subset, not the entire live port's behavior.

Details beyond the seed include complete-subtree selection checks and prepared UUID/version reuse (chatDiagramTools.ts:75-112,216-267), SSE preview thresholds and snapshot backlog allowance (agentChatRoutes.ts:23-90), and receipts stored before persistence with connection validation after application (generationCanvasBridge.ts:54-89). These receipts establish behavior only for isolated controllers; they do not establish live-canvas deduplication.

I did not adopt the critique's cross-collection claims about shared projection instances or downstream context-status algorithms: their supporting implementations are not pinned here. Related-point pointers use only context.json's relationship IDs. ChatStore, ChatStream assembly, controller internals and evaluation reconciliation remain outside the supplied implementation evidence. Failure-path qualifications describe visible control flow, not reproduced runtime failures.

diagrams.ascii:
Agent Chat Orchestration
|-- [M/O] Interactive client and application boundary
|   |-- AgentChatPanel exposes conversations, settings, turns and pending answers
|   |   `-- Owns tabs, drafts and active stream; closing a tab retains the conversation
|   |-- HTTP routes -> AgentChatService: session actions, tools and event subscriptions
|   |   `-- Public responses hide tool definitions, generation receipts and result history
|   |-- Service retains session/thread indexes and coordinates injected capabilities
|   |   |-- ChatStore loads/saves conversations; CodexConnection carries RPC and events
|   |   `-- Canvas reader, tool binding and tool adapter connect a turn to its canvas
|   `-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService [related point: agent-api]
|       `-- Chat owns access/target preparation; downstream API owns edit execution
|-- [C/D] One interactive turn: captured input -> app-server -> visible transcript
|   |-- Create -> thread/start with chat instructions/tools -> persist conversation
|   |-- Resume -> reuse a local session or import a native thread without canvas tools
|   |   `-- Import preserves native history/instructions/cwd/model; active threads reject
|   |-- Send / Read Canvas -> startTurn: admit request, capture context, submit once
|   |   |-- Send contributes text and selected references captured for this turn
|   |   `-- Read Canvas contributes the complete short context as read_canvas output
|   |-- Request identity suppresses repeat submissions; it does not prove execution
|   |-- Native tool call or bound HTTP call -> validate active conversation -> dispatch
|   |   |-- gen-alternatives enters the child-generation workflow below
|   |   `-- Diagram operations require writable access and validated current targets
|   |-- Prepared edit = tool arguments + captured references + current document snapshot
|   |   `-- Resolved operations + base revisions + snapshot version -> submitDirect
|   |-- App-server events -> owning chat -> reduced session -> SSE -> panel transcript
|   |   `-- Snapshot previews and full-item retrieval serve different reading needs
|   |-- Questions/approvals -> pending request -> panel answer -> connection.respond
|   |-- turn/completed -> settle open items and pending requests -> persist final state
|   `-- Idle tool reload retains the thread and refreshes tools through its MCP connection
|-- [C/D] Alternatives: shared source input -> separate child turns -> candidate views
|   |-- Require writable parent, tools, a user message and a source canvas; reject nesting
|   |-- Request ID + input/source signature -> existing receipt or conflict on changed input
|   |-- Persist child records and parent receipt -> request candidate views on source canvas
|   |   `-- Capture source history; retain inputHistory separately from evolving child output
|   |-- Optional saved AgentContext supplies child reference data [related point: contexts]
|   |   `-- Library read supplies resolvedSnapshot when available, otherwise snapshot
|   |-- Schedule candidate launches together; each owns a thread and canvas tool binding
|   |   |-- Saved context -> new thread with captured context injected as reference data
|   |   `-- Otherwise fork parent history at its turn boundary and include trigger context
|   |-- Clear inherited goal so each child executes one managed generation turn
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge supplies isolated controllers [related point: canvas]
|   |   |-- Shared captured history initializes each candidate's independent editable state
|   |   `-- Candidate edits export its own history; siblings do not consume those edits
|   |-- Same CanvasSessionPort boundary routes live IDs to the injected live canvas port
|   |   `-- Isolated IDs expose a restricted command subset and require exact binding
|   |-- Candidate model input combines shared task, candidate prompt and inherited settings
|   |   `-- Usage subtracts a baseline once complete last-request token usage is available
|   |-- finishGeneration -> retain terminal child state -> synchronize source candidate view
|   |   |-- Finished candidates publish history; failed/cancelled candidates publish metadata
|   |   `-- Retained output permits later synchronization when the source is available
|   |-- Children grouped by runId + parent -> optional observer [related point: evals]
|   |   `-- Observer failure is caught; retained child chats and views permit reconciliation
|   `-- Evaluation rerun reuses the child executor with retained source history/settings
|       `-- Stable workspace identity helps reconnect when the live canvas ID changes
`-- [O] State survives according to its owner and publication boundary
    |-- Service + ChatStore retain conversations, generation receipts and child histories
    |   |-- Generated chats remain available for review; iteration starts a new generation
    |   `-- Restart interrupts running chats/items and marks active generations failed
    |-- Stop on a parent cancels active child generations before interrupting its own turn
    |-- Controller lifetime ends after terminal persistence and attempted synchronization
    |   `-- Resource release depends on settlement reaching its cleanup block
    |-- StdioCodexConnection owns the app-server process and outstanding request promises
    |   |-- First request starts/initializes the process; replies correlate to pending RPCs
    |   `-- Process loss rejects RPCs; service clears bindings and fails active work
    |-- Service disposal settles active work, clears bindings and disposes its connection
    |-- Each SSE response owns its subscription; panel owns its EventSource and ChatStream
    |   `-- Response close and panel selection cleanup release their respective resources
    `-- Persistent child history outlives the temporary controller used to compute it
        `-- Source-view synchronization is a separate step from saving the child conversation

Turn admission, retry and tool binding
|-- [O/D] Panel retry identity retains the original request body
|   |-- Send matches text + references + canvas; reused body keeps old settings
|   |-- Read Canvas matches workspace/document and reuses its captured body
|   `-- ChatRequestError clears the entry; uncertain failures retain it
|-- [C] startTurn checks known requestId before running/starting/reloading guards
|   |-- Resume thread if needed -> clone canvas/references -> bind MCP
|   |-- Append requestId -> save session -> issue turn/start
|   `-- Submission failure marks chat failed without removing the appended ID
|       `-- A same-ID retry can return even when turn/start never succeeded
|-- [M/C] Two gates into dispatchTool
|   |-- Native: tools enabled, allowed name, no namespace, running chat
|   |   `-- Match turn ID when the session already knows its active turn
|   |-- HTTP: valid binding token, running, tools enabled, not reloading
|   |   `-- Allowed name required; binding origin uses the listening local port
|   `-- Clone tool context; pair transport call ID with turn ID
`-- [C] Reload refreshes MCP tools on the existing thread
    |-- Idle guard -> snapshot definitions -> unsubscribe/resume
    |-- Reload mapping MCP -> verify every chat_<name> in inventory
    |-- Inject updated guidance -> persist definitions and canvasTools
    `-- Native dynamic tool definitions remain fixed at thread/start

Preparing current, retryable edit inputs
|-- [D] Resolve a batch against one document snapshot
|   |-- Accept 1..20 operations; each requires reference XOR nodeId
|   |-- Reference supplies canvas/display ID/revision; else use turn canvas
|   |-- Cached canvas attachment -> session ID -> resolve argument aliases
|   |-- Require one canvas document; check diagram identity and base revision
|   `-- Explicit revision must agree with reference; report operations[index]
|-- [D] Node selection must describe complete replacement subtrees
|   |-- Find selected roots whose parents are outside the selection
|   |-- Expand root ranges; expanded members must exactly equal selection
|   |-- Reject reference selection combined with explicit contentNodeIds
|   `-- Reject subtree targets in whole-diagram mode; validate ranges
|-- [O/C] Prepared edit cache pins the downstream request
|   |-- Key: [chat ID, requestId]; signature includes tool name + parsed input
|   |-- Same signature reuses preparation, including version and new UUID
|   |-- Changed arguments reject; preparation failure removes cache entry
|   |-- Cache holds at most 500 entries; submitDirect may be called on retry
|   `-- Returned runId -> owning chat; status/cancel require that owner
|       `-- Ownership is in memory and is lost on backend restart
`-- [D] Projection preparation uses transport toolCallId as retry identity
    |-- Cache resolved diagram IDs, expectedVersion and generated requestId
    `-- Missing transport ID falls back to a new UUID per call

Transcript delivery and visibility
|-- [C] Service deltas -> reducer -> listeners
|   |-- Adjacent matching item ID/kind deltas concatenate; flush after 32 ms
|   `-- Large bursts, non-delta messages and get() can flush earlier
|-- [M] Public projection removes toolDefinitions and generationRequests
|   `-- Generation projection removes history; inputHistory remains visible
|-- [D] SSE snapshot previews apply only to non-inProgress tool items
|   |-- Text or any diff > 1000 chars triggers a bounded preview
|   |-- Text: last 3 lines; diffs: first 3; truncate each line to 240 chars
|   |-- Ordinary session GET and individual item GET retain full item text
|   `-- Multiple items -> empty partial snapshot + one item per part
|-- [O] Each response owns its subscription and 15-second heartbeat
|   |-- Identity encoding and flushed headers start streaming immediately
|   |-- Snapshot bytes receive temporary backlog allowance until drained
|   |-- Additional queued bytes > 2 MiB beyond allowance -> destroy response
|   `-- Response close clears heartbeat and unsubscribes
`-- [C/O] Panel feeds parsed events into its ChatStream instance
    |-- Active-session/attempt change -> close EventSource and dispose buffer
    |-- Opening/hiding panel updates stream visibility
    |-- While open, running inactive tabs refresh summaries every 2500 ms
    `-- Snapshot assembly internals are outside the pinned sources

Isolated controller commands and result publication
|-- [O/D] Bridge.add builds controller from captured document + head view
|   |-- Fresh history context ID; generation ID is canvas and document ID
|   `-- Entry retains controller, persistence callback, receipts and queue
|-- [M] Isolated dispatch requires exact document binding
|   |-- Missing generation-* ID rejects; other unknown IDs delegate live
|   |-- Reads: identity, context, document-state, read and snapshot
|   |-- Writes: apply, batch/revision, create-diagrams and diagram-context
|   |-- canvas-view list is empty; save acknowledges current state
|   `-- Other view operations reject; checkpoint checks expectedVersion
|-- [C/O] Per-controller queue serializes commands and survives rejection
|   |-- Mutation receipt key: method + requestId; signature: full command
|   |-- Changed signature rejects; first application retains result receipt
|   |-- Receipt is stored BEFORE exported history is persisted
|   `-- Identical retry reuses result and retries persistence without reapply
|-- [D] Batch/revision applies changes, then validates connection anchors
|   `-- Returned unresolvedEdgeIds reports invalid edges after application
|-- [C/O] finishGeneration classifies and saves the child before source sync
|   |-- Cancelled/interrupted -> cancelled; idle -> finished; else failed
|   |-- Capture controller history, falling back to retained child history
|   |-- Terminal child save precedes the synchronization try/finally
|   |-- Sync failure retains result; finally clears binding and controller
|   |   `-- Remove resumed marker and attempt thread/unsubscribe
|   `-- Failure of the earlier child save can bypass that cleanup
`-- [D/C] Source publication combines child result, source identity and view ID
    |-- Sync recovery requires exactly one matching stable workspace/document
    |-- Update requestId combines runId, child ID and generation status
    |-- generations() retries unsynced terminal results and reports pendingSave
    `-- These receipts prove isolated behavior only; live-port internals are absent
